card.name: Digits inside numbers and section references
card.fires_on: A single digit or decimal point in the middle of a multi-part number. Typical cases are year ranges, confidence intervals, and section cross-references such as (2.2) or 5.27.

modes.label: Digits in years and ranges
modes.description: A digit inside a year or numeric range, before the number is finished.

modes.label: Section reference numbers
modes.description: The dot or digit in a bracketed section reference such as (2.2) or (4.2).

card.plain: It fires on a digit or dot partway through a number, such as a year or a section number like 2.2.
